unauthorized.message: The page you are trying to view is only available to administrators.

usageSummary.description: Summarizes the current usage of your deployment, including compute resources, model storage, and any limits that have been configured.

trainingEvalHoursUsed.label: Training and evaluation hours used
trainingEvalHoursUsed.popover: This shows the number of hours that have been spent on training and evaluating machine learning users on your deployment.

modelsStored.label: Models stored
modelsStored.popover: This shows the total number of models currently stored on your deployment across all users.

storageUsed.label: Storage used
storageUsed.popover: This shows the total amount of storage space used by all models across all users on your deployment.

numberOfUsers.label: Number of users
numberOfUsers.popover: This shows the total number of users who are registered on your deployment.

globalComputeLimit.label: Global compute usage limit
globalComputeLimit.popover: This shows the maximum total compute hours that can be used across all users in your deployment for training and evaluation.

globalModelLimit.label: Global model count limit
globalModelLimit.popover: This shows the maximum total number of models that can be stored across all users in your deployment.

newUserComputeLimit.label: New user compute usage limit
newUserComputeLimit.popover: This shows the default compute usage limit that will be assigned to new users. To change this, click New user quotas and update New user compute usage limit.

newUserModelLimit.label: New user model count limit
newUserModelLimit.popover: This shows the default model count limit that will be assigned to new users. To change this, click New user quotas and update New user model count limit.

profilesTable.usageLimitPopover: The maximum number of training and evaluation hours an individual user can consume. This can be changed by selecting the checkbox in the user's row and clicking Actions > Update usage quotas.
profilesTable.modelLimitPopover: The maximum number of models an individual user can have. This can be changed by selecting the checkbox in the user's row and clicking Actions > Update usage quotas.
profilesTable.filterPlaceholder: Find user by alias or email
profilesTable.filterPopover:
Search for users by alias or email address. Examples:
Alias: "john" matches "John Smith" or "johnson"
Email: "example.com" matches any user with that domain
